short_scenes.caption: Zor.
short_scenes.narration: Zor stepped out of the shadows and grabbed the boy. Your father took what was mine. Now I take what is his.

short_scenes.caption: "LEO!"
short_scenes.narration: In the village, Mia screamed his name. Only Leo's tiny footprints, and much bigger ones beside them.

short_scenes.caption: John picked up his spear.
short_scenes.narration: John picked up his spear. Mia grabbed a burning torch. I'm coming too, she said.

short_scenes.caption: Into the Dark Forest.
short_scenes.narration: The tracks led into the Dark Forest, where no one had ever come back.
